title: Applicant rejection-email batch data workflow - 2026 template evidence
summary: Recent workbook template suggests a batch rejection-email workflow driven by position, applicant first/last name, county and rejection reason. The supplied workbook does not contain the actual email wording or enough evidence to establish the complete workflow.

claims.claim: The rejection-email workbook is structured around Position, First, Last, County and Reason fields.
The template appears intended to stage applicant data for rejection communications, but the actual generation/sending mechanism is not contained in this workbook.

controls: The user has separately established that outbound applicant communications should remain human-reviewed before sending.
unresolved_questions: What process or script consumes this workbook?
Where is the approved rejection-email template text stored?
How is the Reason field translated into applicant-facing language?
What approvals or review occur before a rejection email is sent?
automation_candidates: Connect final applicant disposition to a human-reviewed rejection draft.
Generate standardized drafts from approved reason categories without exposing internal notes verbatim.
Track sent/not-sent status and communication date.

provenance.notes: Recent template; currentness refers to source recency, not proof the workflow is active.
